description: Kavach Open-Source Scam Pattern Rules for India

rules.name: Fake KYC / Account Blocked Alert
rules.explanation: Scammers falsely claim your bank account, card, or YONO app is blocked due to missing KYC or PAN details to induce panic.
rules.advice: Banks NEVER ask you to update KYC or PAN via SMS links or calls. Visit your home bank branch or use the official mobile banking app directly.
rules.source: RBI BE(A)WARE booklet (Part A: Phishing Links & Vishing Calls)

rules.name: Electricity Bill Disconnection Threat
patterns: बिजली\s+(?:काट|बंद)\s+(?:दी जाएगी|हो जाएगी|कर दी जाएगी).*?(?:आज रात|अपडेट नहीं)
rules.explanation: Viral scam claiming your home electricity will be disconnected tonight because of an un-updated bill, urging you to call an unofficial personal mobile number.
rules.advice: Electricity discoms never send sudden disconnection threats via personal SMS or provide individual mobile numbers. Check pending bills only on your discom's official website or official consumer app.
rules.source: PIB Fact Check & DoT Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu Electricity Scam Advisories)

rules.name: FedEx / Courier Drug Parcel & Digital Arrest Scam
patterns: (?:stay on|do not disconnect|must remain on).*?(?:video call|skype|whatsapp call)
(?:arrest warrant|digital arrest warrant).*?(?:cbi|ed|customs|cyber crime|mumbai police|delhi police)
rules.explanation: Criminals pose as FedEx, Customs, Police, or CBI officials claiming a parcel in your name contains narcotics, then place you under an illegal 'digital arrest' over video call to extort money.
rules.advice: There is NO provision for 'digital arrest' under Indian law. Real law enforcement agencies never interrogate citizens, demand money, or serve warrants over Skype or WhatsApp. Hang up and report immediately to 1930.
rules.source: MHA Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) & PIB Digital Arrest Advisory

rules.name: UPI PIN Requested to Receive Money / Collect Request
rules.explanation: Tricks you into believing entering your UPI PIN will deposit money into your account. In reality, a UPI PIN only AUTHORIZES OUTGOING PAYMENTS.
rules.advice: YOU NEVER ENTER A UPI PIN TO RECEIVE MONEY. UPI PIN is exclusively used for sending money (debit). If anyone asks for your PIN to send you money or a refund, it is 100% a scam.
rules.source: NPCI UPI Safety Guidelines & RBI BE(A)WARE booklet (Part A: Online Selling Platforms & UPI)

rules.name: Task-Based / Like & Review Job Scam
patterns: (?:यूट्यूब वीडियो लाइक|होटल रिव्यू).*?(?:करके पैसे कमाएं|टेलीग्राम जॉइन)
rules.explanation: Offers unrealistic daily income (₹2,000–₹5,000/day) for trivial tasks like liking YouTube videos or writing Google Maps reviews, leading to fake prepaid investment traps.
rules.advice: Legitimate companies do not pay high daily sums for liking videos or require you to join Telegram groups. Never pay 'deposit fees' or 'VIP upgrade charges' to unlock earned money.
rules.source: PIB & I4C Advisory on Part-Time Telegram Task Scams

rules.name: KBC / Lucky Draw / Lottery Winner Scam
patterns: (?:processing fee|registration fee|gst fee|transfer charge).*?(?:to claim|claim your prize|release lottery)
rules.explanation: False announcement that your phone number won ₹25 Lakhs or a luxury car in a KBC/Jio lucky draw, requiring an upfront 'processing fee' or 'tax' deposit.
rules.advice: Neither KBC nor Jio conducts lotteries via WhatsApp or SMS. Any 'lottery' requiring an advance fee to release funds is a certified fraud.
rules.source: RBI BE(A)WARE booklet (Part A: Lottery Frauds) & PIB Fact Check

rules.name: Remote Access App (AnyDesk/TeamViewer) or OTP Request
rules.explanation: Impersonators instruct you to download remote desktop apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) or share confidential OTPs, allowing them to mirror your screen and siphon funds.
rules.advice: NEVER download AnyDesk, QuickSupport, or TeamViewer at the instruction of an unsolicited caller or message. Genuine bank staff will NEVER ask for your OTP or remote screen access.
rules.source: RBI BE(A)WARE booklet (Part A: Screen-Sharing Apps) & CERT-In Advisories

rules.name: Instant Fake Loan App / No Documents Offer
patterns: (?:बिना किसी दस्तावेज़|बिना सिबिल|जीरो डॉक्यूमेंट).*?(?:तुरंत लोन|पर्सनल लोन|लोन अप्रूव्ड)
(?:तुरंत लोन|लोन पास).*?(?:5 मिनट में|सीधे खाते में).*?(?:एपीके डाउनलोड|लिंक पर क्लिक)
(?:ஆவணங்கள் இன்றி|சிபில் ஸ்கோர் இன்றி|ஆவணம் இல்லாமல்).*?(?:உடனடி கடன்|பர்சனல் லோன்)
rules.explanation: Predatory illegal lending apps lure borrowers with promises of instant loans without verification, then siphon phone contacts/photos to extort and harass.
rules.advice: Only take loans from RBI-registered Banks and NBFCs listed on the RBI website. Never sideload loan APK files from SMS links or third-party web pages.
rules.source: RBI Digital Lending Guidelines & CERT-In Digital Safety Compass

rules.name: Guaranteed Returns / Stock Tips / VIP Crypto Group
rules.explanation: Fraudulent groups promise unrealistically high, guaranteed profits with zero risk in stocks or cryptocurrencies to execute pump-and-dump or fake platform scams.
rules.advice: Guaranteed returns do not exist in securities or financial markets. SEBI does not allow guaranteed-return promises. Never trade on advice from random WhatsApp/Telegram groups.
rules.source: SEBI Investor Advisories & RBI BE(A)WARE booklet (Part B: Ponzi / MLM Schemes)

rules.name: Impersonating TRAI / Police / DoT / Gov Authority
patterns: (?:mumbai police|delhi police|cbi|crime branch|cyber cell).*?(?:arrest warrant|fir registered|complaint filed|legal action against you)
(?:income tax department|tax refund).*?(?:refund of rs\.?|approved).*?(?:confirm bank account|click here to claim)
(?:ट्राई|दूरसंचार विभाग).*?(?:मोबाइल नंबर|सिम).*?(?:\d+ घंटे में|बंद कर दिया जाएगा)
(?:டிராய்|தொலைத்தொடர்பு ஒழுங்குமுறை ஆணையம்).*?(?:சிம் கார்டு|மொபைல் எண்).*?(?:\d+ மணி நேரத்தில்|முடக்கப்படும்)
rules.explanation: Threatens immediate disconnection of your phone number by impersonating TRAI or Telecom Department, or intimidates with fake Police/CBI FIR notices.
rules.advice: TRAI NEVER contacts individual subscribers to disconnect numbers or verify KYC. Legitimate police never serve arrest notices or settle cases through messaging apps or calls.
rules.source: TRAI Public Advisory on Mobile Disconnection Threats & DoT Sanchar Saathi

url_rules.name: Obfuscated URL Shortener
url_rules.explanation: Message uses an obfuscated URL shortener to hide the real destination website.
url_rules.advice: Do not click on shortened links from unknown senders as they frequently disguise malicious phishing or APK download sites.

url_rules.name: Raw IP Address Link
url_rules.explanation: Message links directly to an IP address instead of a verified, registered domain name.
url_rules.advice: Legitimate institutions and businesses never send direct IP address links to customers.

url_rules.name: Direct Android APK Download Link
url_rules.explanation: Message encourages downloading and sideloading an Android APK package directly onto your phone.
url_rules.advice: Never download or install APK files from SMS, WhatsApp, or websites. Sideloaded APKs can read your SMS, intercept banking OTPs, and steal accounts.

url_rules.name: Fake Government Portal Lookalike
url_rules.explanation: Domain pretends to be an official Indian government service (e-Challan, Parivahan, PM Yojana, Aadhaar, Income Tax) but is NOT hosted on official .gov.in or .nic.in domains.
url_rules.advice: All genuine Government of India websites exclusively end with .gov.in or .nic.in. Any other domain ending (.com, .org, .top, .live) claiming to be government is fraudulent.

url_rules.name: Fake Bank Portal Lookalike
url_rules.explanation: Domain mimics a major bank (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, YONO) paired with keywords like 'kyc', 'update', or 'login' on an unofficial address.
url_rules.advice: Never enter banking credentials or netbanking passwords on third-party links. Always type the bank URL directly or use the official mobile application.

url_rules.name: Suspicious Top-Level Domain (TLD)
url_rules.explanation: Link uses a cheap/disposable top-level domain frequently utilized in automated phishing campaigns.
url_rules.advice: Be cautious when visiting links ending in high-risk disposable domains.

mitigation_rules.name: Legitimate Bank OTP Security Warning
mitigation_rules.pattern: (?:do not share (?:this )?otp|never share (?:your )?(?:otp|password|pin)|bank never (?:calls|asks)|otp is confidential|valid for \d+ mins?|do not disclose)
mitigation_rules.explanation: Message contains standard banking security advisory discouraging OTP disclosure.

mitigation_rules.name: Standard Bank Transaction Alert
mitigation_rules.pattern: (?:debited by|debited from|credited to|credited with|avail(?:able)?\s*bal(?:ance)?:?\s*(?:inr|rs\.?)|a\/c\s*(?:no\.?)?\s*(?:xx|\.\.)\d{2,4}|if not done by you|sms block to)
mitigation_rules.explanation: Standard transactional alert format typically dispatched by regulated commercial banks.

mitigation_rules.name: Legitimate E-Commerce / Courier Notification
mitigation_rules.pattern: (?:out for delivery|delivered|order (?:#|no\.?)|package has been delivered|share delivery pin.*?only when package|happy journey.*?irctc|pnr\s*\d{10})
mitigation_rules.explanation: Standard logistical status notification from verified e-commerce or railway service.

mitigation_rules.name: Legitimate Utility Payment Confirmation
mitigation_rules.pattern: (?:thank you for (?:your )?payment of rs\.?|bill payment of rs\.?|payment received towards (?:electricity|water|gas)|receipt no\.?|consumer no\.?)
mitigation_rules.explanation: Official receipt acknowledgement confirming a successfully completed utility bill payment.
